composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Idempotent create: if this request carries an 'Idempotency-Key' already seen from a prior
# successful create, replay the originally created owner (200) instead of creating a duplicate.
# Runs first, before any validation or duplicate check, and publishes the key for recordIdempotency.
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotencyKey
  next: validate

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  next: validatePostcode

# Validate the postcode WHEN PRESENT (optional when absent), so an out-of-range postcode
# for the city's region is a 400 before the owner is built.
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerPostcode
  next: validateRegistrationDate

# Reject a SUPPLIED registrationDate later than the server date as a 400, before the date is
# resolved/defaulted. A request that omits the date stays accepted.
validateRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateRegistrationDate
  next: normalizeTelephone

normalizeTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  next: normalizeEmail

normalizeEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
  next: rejectDisposableEmail

# Reject a supplied email whose domain is on the disposable-domain blocklist as a 400. Runs after
# normalizeEmail so the domain is already syntactically valid and lower-cased.
rejectDisposableEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectDisposableEmailDomain
  next: resolveRegistrationDate

# Resolve the effective registration date (supplied-or-default, rolled forward off weekends)
# before the daily limit, so the limit counts owners per the same adjusted business day.
resolveRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ResolveRegistrationDate
  next: ensureCityCapacity

ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyLimit

ensureDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

# Consolidated duplicate detection: reject 409 only when the new owner's WHOLE derived identityKey
# (SHA-256 hex over normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)) equals an existing owner's.
# The identityKey is the single identity rule; the computed householdId no longer contributes.
ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: flagPossibleDuplicate

# Soft duplicate: not a hard identity collision (already rejected above), but its identityKey differs
# while soundex(lastName) and postcode both match an existing owner. Still created; flagged with
# possibleDuplicate/possibleDuplicateOf so the response can surface the likely match.
flagPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdSize

assignHouseholdSize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdSize
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: defaultRegistrationDate

defaultRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.DefaultOwnerRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMemberId

assignMemberId:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMemberId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignBulkSignupWarning

assignBulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCapacityWarning

# Flag capacityWarning when the owner's city already held 40-49 owners (approaching the hard limit
# of 50). Runs before save, so the owner being created is not yet persisted and never counts itself.
assignCapacityWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCapacityWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: capMembershipLevel

# Capture the household-capped membershipLevel: the naturally computed level, but no more than one
# above the current maximum among existing household members. Runs after householdSize/namesakeCount
# are set (the level's inputs) and before save, so the capped value is persisted.
capMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CapMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# Emit an AUDIT line for the created owner (id assigned by save) before responding.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: notifyWelcome

# Enqueue a welcome notification: emit a NOTIFY line carrying the owner id (assigned by

  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

I've now read the endpoint YAML and every function class in the pipeline. Here is the complete, in-order account of what `POST /api/owners` does.

## Guard (before any step)

- **Authorization** — `composition.authorize: hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`. The whole endpoint requires the `OWNER_ADMIN` role; otherwise it never runs (403 / `AuthorizationDeniedException`).

## The pipeline (27 steps, in order)

Steps are marked **[V]** validation (can reject) or **[S]** side-effect (mutation / persistence / I/O). From `ensureCityCapacity` onward everything runs under `govern: [ transaction ]`, so all writes commit once at the very end.

1. **CheckIdempotencyKey** — **[V]/[S]** Reads optional `Idempotency-Key` header. Publishes the key for later. If that key was already seen from a prior successful create, throws `IdempotentReplayException` → short-circuits and replays the original owner as **200** (no validation, no duplicate created).

2. **ValidateOwnerFields** — **[S] then [V]** Normalizes `addressLine1`/`addressLine2`/`address` in place; if structured `addressLine1` is present, (re)composes the flat `address` from the two lines. Then requires `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, `telephone` to be non-blank (after normalization) → **400** `MissingOwnerFieldsException` listing each offending field. Publishes the body.

3. **ValidateOwnerPostcode** — **[V]** Only if `postcode` is present: must be exactly 4 digits, and if the city maps to a known region (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099) must fall in that range → **400** `InvalidPostcodeException`. Absent postcode is accepted.

4. **ValidateRegistrationDate** — **[V]** Only if `registrationDate` is supplied: must not be after the server's current date → **400** `FutureRegistrationDateException`. Absent date is accepted.

5. **NormalizeOwnerTelephone** — **[V]/[S]** Rewrites `telephone` to E.164 in place (strips separators, defaults country code `+61`, drops a leading national `0`, requires 8–15 digits) → invalid gives **400** `InvalidTelephoneException`.

6. **NormalizeOwnerEmail** — **[V]/[S]** Email is optional; if present it must match the syntax pattern → **400** `InvalidEmailException`, and is lower-cased in place.

7. **RejectDisposableEmailDomain** — **[V]** If present, the email's domain must not be on the blocklist (`mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`) → **400** `DisposableEmailDomainException`.

8. **ResolveRegistrationDate** — **[S]** Computes the effective registration date (supplied, else today), rolled forward off Saturdays/Sundays and fixed 2026 public holidays to the next business day. Publishes it (used by the daily-limit checks, the stored date, and the memberId year).

9. **EnsureCityCapacity** — **[V]** Rejects if the owner's city already holds ≥ 50 owners (case-insensitive count, excludes the new owner) → **409** `CityAtCapacityException`.

10. **EnsureDailyLimit** — **[V]** Rejects if ≥ 100 owners already have that effective registration date → **429** `DailyLimitReachedException`.

11. **BuildOwner** — **[S]** Maps the validated DTO into a new `Owner` entity via `OwnerMapper`.

12. **AssignHousehold** — **[S]** Sets `householdId` = first 12 hex of SHA-256 over `normalizedLastName|postcode|V2` (null when no postcode).

13. **EnsureUniqueIdentity** — **[V]** Rejects if the new owner's whole `identityKey` (SHA-256 over `normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)`) equals a non-soft-deleted existing owner's → **409** `DuplicateIdentityException`.

14. **FlagPossibleDuplicate** — **[S]** Sets `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf`. Flags a soft match when identityKey differs but `soundex(lastName)` **and** postcode both match an existing owner (lowest matching id). Skipped when the request declares `sharesHousehold`, or postcode is absent.

15. **AssignHouseholdSize** — **[S]** Sets `householdSize` = existing members sharing the `householdId` + 1 (or 1 when no household).

16. **DefaultOwnerRegistrationDate** — **[S]** Writes the resolved effective date onto the owner (overwriting any raw supplied weekend date).

17. **AssignMemberId** — **[S]** Sets `memberId` = `<REGION><FY><HASH8><Luhn>`; on collision appends `-<n>` (smallest n ≥ 2) to make it unique.

18. **AssignNamesakeCount** — **[S]** Sets `namesakeCount` = existing owners sharing `firstName`+`lastName` (case-insensitive; excludes the new owner).

19. **AssignBulkSignupWarning** — **[S]** Sets `bulkSignupWarning` = true when > 80 owners already exist on that effective date.

20. **AssignCapacityWarning** — **[S]** Sets `capacityWarning` = true when the city already held 40–49 owners.

21. **CapMembershipLevel** — **[S]** Sets `membershipLevel` = the naturally computed level, capped at one above the max effective level among existing household members.

22. **SaveOwner** — **[S]** Persists the owner via `OwnerRepository.save` (assigns the database id).
